Include rubble, exposed wires, hanging cables, cracked glass, scattered debris, and a cylindrical broken machine on the lower right foreground. Mood is lonely, awe-inspiring, post-apocalyptic sci-fi exploration; high contrast chiaroscuro lighting, volumetric dust beams, cold desaturated grays and blacks with subtle blue highlights, photorealistic texture, sharp detail, 16:9 aspect ratio, no text, no watermark.
